author: chocomintforest
quote: Ive been a big fan of GTA since the San Andreas days and was looking forward to this one for a long time. However, the characters are absolutely obnoxious. Jason has no personality whatsoever or any self respect dating Lucia, who disrespects and belittles him at every chance she gets. I can not believe im forced to hear her yap every damn mission. This is not GTA anymore
